hypothesised_pattern: The target rises above the base prediction when x2 and x5 have the same sign and when |x4| is large, and falls below it when x2 and x5 have opposite signs and x4 is near zero.
functional_form_guess: a*x2*x5 + b*(x4**2 - 1), possibly inside a sigmoid since targets lie in (0, 1)
rationale: The five positive residuals all have x2*x5 > 0 (about 0.75 to 2.2) and |x4| of at least 1.06, while the five negative residuals all have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.9 to -2.2) and |x4| of at most 0.33. The base predictions cluster at 0.3-0.68 regardless, which shows it misses both the sign-agreement interaction and the even x4 effect.
